tools.name: Spellsteal
limitations: Steals one beneficial Magic effect instead of merely removing it

tools.name: Remove Curse
limitations: Eight-second cooldown before Improved Remove Curse

tools.name: Time Warp
limitations: Thirty percent Haste for forty seconds
Applies the shared ten-minute exhaustion effect

tools.name: Arcane Intellect
limitations: Three percent Intellect for one hour
Does not stack with an equivalent Arcane Intellect effect

tools.name: Prismatic Barrier
limitations: Personal absorb and Magic mitigation only

provenance.description: Current Midnight Arcane guide identifies Time Warp, Counterspell, Arcane Intellect, Spellsteal, Remove Curse, Polymorph, and Prismatic Barrier.
Current Time Warp record confirms Mage Bloodlust-equivalent behavior, duration, shared lockout, and spell identifier.
Current Arcane Intellect record confirms the party-wide three-percent Intellect effect.
